title: Mapping AI Economic Complexity
abstract: arXiv:2609.17200v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Green economic complexity provides a generalizable framework for examining countries' productive capabilities in a defined product set. We apply this framework to AI-enabling goods within the full product space, linking current specialization with adjacent diversification opportunities. Using BACI exports for 2007-2023 and 103 AI-enabling goods, we measure complexity-weighted specialization (AECI), product-level adjacent opportunities (AIAP), and average complexity-weighted relatedness of remaining candidates (AECP). In 2023, Japan leads AECI, while China leads AECP; portfolio breadth accounts for much of the variation in raw AECI. Initial raw potential is positively associated with subsequent changes in the AI-enabling export share, but its associations with changes in AECI and specialization counts are not statistically significant at the 5% level. translated_abstract: 绿色经济复杂度为考察各国在特定产品集合中的生产能力提供了一个可推广的框架。我们将该框架应用于整个产品空间中的AI使能产品，将当前的专业化与邻近的多样化机会联系起来。利用2007-2023年BACI出口数据和103种AI使能产品，我们测度了复杂度加权的专业化指数（AECI）、产品层面的邻近机会（AIAP）以及剩余候选产品的平均复杂度加权关联度（AECP）。2023年，日本在AECI上领先，而中国在AECP上领先；产品组合的广度在很大程度上解释了原始AECI的差异。初始的原始潜力与随后AI使能产品出口份额的变化呈正相关，但其与AECI变化和专业化产品数量变化的关联在5%水平上不具有统计显著性。我们的贡献在于提供了一种基于贸易数据的AI使能生产能力评估方法。
tldr: 该论文将经济复杂度框架拓展至AI使能产品领域，基于2007-2023年贸易数据构建了AECI等指标，评估各国AI生产能力，发现日本在复杂度加权专业化上领先，而中国在邻近多样化潜力上最具优势。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the economic complexity framework to AI-enabling goods using 2007-2023 trade data, introducing complexity-weighted measures that reveal Japan leads in AI specialization while China holds the greatest adjacent diversification potential.
